subject: Intro demo — FlowRetail (replatforming checkout, volume & timeline)
messages:
From: Samira Kahn <samira@flowretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in a demo — FlowRetail checkout migration

Hi Logan,

We just signed up for a trial on Redwood this morning — Samira here, Head of Platform at FlowRetail. We're replatforming our checkout and want to evaluate Redwood for low-latency personalization + recommendation scoring at inference. A couple quick details: 

- Primary use case: tokenized product recommendations + checkout fraud scoring (model will be a mix of in-house transformers and an open-recommendation model).
- Volume: ~1.2M inference requests/day projected during peak season, average payload ~300 tokens.
- Timeline: pilot in January, production by end of Q1 2027.

I've attached a short use-case brief. Can we set up a product demo this week or next to walk through performance, dedicated options, and integration points? Our CTO (cc'd) would join for architecture questions.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Kahn
Head of Platform, FlowRetail
attachment: flowretail-usecase-brief.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Samira Kahn <samira@flowretail.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — FlowRetail checkout migration

Hi Samira — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood. Thanks for the brief, that helps a lot. Quick checks from our side so we make the demo as useful as possible: 

1) Which latency SLO are you targeting for the recommendation path (p95 target)?
2) Is the inference payload encrypted end-to-end today (TLS + customer-managed keys) or would you need our Private offering?
3) Do you expect model updates daily or weekly during the pilot?
4) Any regulatory/compliance constraints (SOC2/PCI scope) we should prepare for?

I can run a short 30–40 minute session demoing: model onboarding, throughput scaling (Dedicated pools), and the Optimize recommendations for cost. Proposed slots:
- Wed 2026-11-04 10:00–10:40 PT
- Thu 2026-11-04 14:00–14:40 PT
- Mon 2026-11-08 09:00–09:40 PT

Or you can pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/logan-redwood/30min

Cc'ing Priyom (solutions) so he can join for architecture + quantization questions.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

From: Samira Kahn <samira@flowretail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — FlowRetail checkout migration

Thanks Logan — quick answers below and apologies, need to shift the meeting time: 

- Latency SLO: p95 <= 120ms for recommendations; fraud scoring can tolerate up to 250ms.
- Encryption/keys: TLS in transit; we are evaluating customer-managed KMS for production (would prefer Private or VPC option for PCI scope).
- Model update cadence: Weekly for the first month of pilot, then daily once we go to production.
- Compliance: PCI scope for checkout, SOC2 would be nice but PCI is primary.

Regarding timing, the Wed/Thu slots overlap with our all-hands. Could we do Fri 2026-11-05 11:00–11:40 PT instead? Our CTO can join then.

Samira
